purpose: Close the Hero card-icon repository-size-reduction work after explicit ownership routing, deterministic external exact-byte source-pack publication, SHA-pinned admission, clean hydration, dedicated owning validation, source-transport cutover, repository source-PNG removal, and post-H6 validator/build/deploy-gate alignment, without reopening frozen Hero semantics or changing production lossless WebP delivery.

resolvedBlockers.cause: The Hero card-icon frontend validator still scanned the repository source-PNG directory after H6 intentionally removed it.
resolvedBlockers.resolution: PR #429 changed the validator to require the external source-pack contract, require the repository source-PNG directory to remain absent, and continue verifying all 267 production lossless WebP files.

resolvedBlockers.cause: The authoritative Pages composed gate still required the deleted Hero card-icon PNG directory even though production delivery uses the frozen lossless WebP set.
resolvedBlockers.resolution: PR #432 removed only the stale positive PNG existence/count checks and preserved WebP delivery checks.

nonBlockingReviews.detail: The GitHub Release was not immutable at H2 admission. Integrity remains fail-closed through pinned archive, inventory, checksum, exact-file-set, and per-file byte hashes; changed bytes require a new tag and contract version.

H1-H8 removes the redundant Hero card-icon source PNG copy from the current repository tree and future commits only. Historical PNG blobs remain in Git history because history rewriting was explicitly out of scope.
PR #393 is a separate Hero detail presentation review. It does not change the Hero card-icon source-pack authority, production lossless WebP delivery, or this closeout.

handoff.nextStart: No H0.5-H8 Hero card-icon source-pack follow-up is required. Any later Hero detail-card artwork externalization, Git-history reduction, new source snapshot, or frontend presentation work is a separate scope and must re-check current repository authority before starting.

The external source pack no longer contains exactly the frozen 267 PNG source files totaling 8990485 bytes or any per-file SHA-256/size differs from the frozen source identity manifest.
